verifyExclusion: Identify the product and its token relationship in official docs. Required watchlist record, screening flag: {exclusion}.
verify: Locate {name} in official docs; match app, chain and contract to the documented deployment; check token and participation terms.
trialSuffix: If fees and terms fit, cap principal at US${capital} {chain}.
follow: Track input, output and receipts; review fee, liquidity and participation terms weekly.
feeStop: Stop if quoted total fees would exceed the fee budget.
exit: Quote a small return swap or redemption to the underlying asset; reconcile output with the receipt; revoke unneeded approvals.
investigateExclusion: Verify the underlying token, its issuer and where it trades; no deposit trial.
investigate: Identify the intended user; read access and withdrawal terms. Unclear access or exit means capital stays at zero.
track: Check the official changelog and eligibility weekly; record access, asset or redemption changes; stop on restrictions.
goNoGo: Require a verified product, eligible account and documented exit before any trial; unknown or gated access means skip.
